# Attention-h1 + vMF-style DEC-loss hybrid pilot

Generated automatically, 2026-09-26 06:00:05.

## Method

Attention-h1 retains the content and affect teacher-graph symmetric InfoNCE losses. Cosine-softmax vMF-style assignments with per-step center normalization, a detached DEC square-and-frequency sharpened target, and train soft-assignment-mass pruning supply the DEC mechanism. The full clean train embedding supplies the DEC loss each epoch; the centers and student weights share one optimizer. There is no embedding noise, discrete reclustering, or Leiden pass.

Each run initializes 100 centers by KMeans(n_init=10, random_state=seed) on its own clean epoch-0 train embedding, L2-normalizes the centroids, then keeps 67 highest-mass trained centers. Raw parameter norm does not measure use of a direction-only vMF center, so pruning uses total soft assignment on the final clean train embedding. LAMBDA_DEC is screened over (0.1, 0.5, 1.0) and kappa over (4.0, 16.0), crossed for six seed-42 cells; DEC weight is linearly warmed up over 30 epochs to avoid premature self-sharpening collapse. Adam starts at 0.001; cosine T_max=200, eta_min=1e-05; checkpoint cadence=5. The plateau stopping rule follows the noise-schedule sibling. Checkpoint all-100 cluster sizes come from that epoch's clean train forward before the optimizer step; checkpoint recalls evaluate the updated model. An early recall plateau may stop before the 30-epoch DEC warmup completes. Silhouette uses a seed-42 draw of at most 6,000 embeddings and silhouette_score with a 4,000-point sample and random_state=42. Undefined silhouette from one-cluster collapse is reported as n/a.

## Final numeric verdict

Against Attention-h1 baseline: emotion AMI does not beat 0.1249 (-0.0063); genre AMI does not beat 0.2404 (-0.1509); silhouette does not beat 0.0392 (-0.0119).

Against Leiden pseudo-contrastive alone: emotion AMI beats 0.1165 (+0.0021); genre AMI does not beat 0.2351 (-0.1456); silhouette does not beat 0.0877 (-0.0604).

Against Noise + schedule alone (winning seed 42): emotion AMI does not beat 0.1306 (-0.0120); genre AMI does not beat 0.1973 (-0.1078); silhouette does not beat 0.0488 (-0.0215).

Against Noise + schedule + pseudo-contrastive: emotion AMI does not beat 0.1210 (-0.0024); genre AMI does not beat 0.2623 (-0.1728); silhouette does not beat 0.0789 (-0.0516).

Against Euclidean DEC hybrid (four-seed mean): emotion AMI beats 0.1160 (+0.0026); genre AMI does not beat 0.1321 (-0.0426); silhouette beats -0.0288 (+0.0561).

Against PercepT replication standing balance-hack: emotion AMI does not beat 0.1252 (-0.0066); genre AMI does not beat 0.2486 (-0.1591); silhouette never measured.

Against PercepT replication faithful recipe: emotion AMI beats 0.1092 (+0.0094); genre AMI does not beat 0.3288 (-0.2393); silhouette does not beat 0.5120 (-0.4847).

Against noise + schedule alone four-seed mean (0.1277/0.2396, silhouette 0.0466), seed-42 signed differences: emotion AMI -0.0091; genre AMI -0.1501; silhouette -0.0193.

Seed-42 selected hybrid closes -2.5% of the held-out silhouette gap from Attention-h1 (0.0392) to faithful PercepT (0.5120); signed difference to faithful PercepT=-0.4847. With a declared 10% gap-closure marker, this is not a meaningful fraction of the gap. It does not exceed every previously measured buddy-variant silhouette. The selected DEC hybrid underperforms every measured buddy variant on held-out silhouette; this is a negative result. It does not clear the seed-42 held-out AMI Pareto bar; 0/4 seeds clear both bars. 0/4 seeds beat the Attention-h1 baseline silhouette. 0/4 seeds beat the strongest measured buddy variant (Leiden pseudo-contrastive). Meaningful gap closure, both AMI bars, and noncollapse hold together in 0/4 seeds: not robust across four seeds; any seed-42 success is seed-dependent.
Geometry-fix verdict: held-out silhouette is positive in 4/4 seeds and reaches or exceeds the best previous buddy silhouette (0.0877) without the post-prune cluster-size collapse in 0/4 seeds. Both held-out AMI Pareto bars clear in 0/4 seeds. The geometry fix does not resolve the collapse robustly; joint silhouette and Pareto success does not hold across all four seeds. This negative or seed-dependent result means the geometry-mismatch hypothesis itself needs to be questioned, not just this particular cosine-kernel fix.
